svg.title: Eight frames. The rerun battled every team against all 50 meta files with the six Pokemon shuffled before each battle. An edit changes one thing on one Pokemon, in one of six kinds, and each kind is tried 3 times on a team. Replays of the unchanged team show battle noise, about 3.40 points. With noise removed, one edit moves win rate by 5.90 points for a whole Pokemon swap, 4.84 for a move, 4.35 for an item, 3.66 for an ability, 1.95 for stat alignment and 1.60 for Stat Points. Only the whole Pokemon swap clears the 5-point cutoff set in the plan on 2026-09-28, and only it passes both tests, from both groups of starting teams.
